Product Suite

Built for every role in the chain

📱
For residents & citizens

The SOS app that never drops the ball

Whether you're in a townhouse complex, on the road, or in an informal settlement — SafetyLink Mobile ensures you're never alone.

  • One-touch SOS with GPS auto-dispatch
  • iTAG BLE keyfob physical panic button
  • USSD fallback for zero-data moments
  • AI voice callback via VAPI on SOS
  • Share live location with up to 5 contacts
  • Incident history and response timeline
🖥️
For security companies

Mission control for armed response

Professional-grade operator deck that turns incoming alerts into coordinated responses — zero configuration overhead.

  • Real-time alert stream with caller profile
  • Live GPS map with unit positions
  • One-click voice callback via VAPI AI
  • Incident log with photo evidence upload
  • Response-time analytics and reporting
  • Multi-estate management from one view
⚙️
For estates & organisations

Your entire community in one pane

Onboard residents, configure response zones, assign operators, view real-time reports — no technical expertise required.

  • Bulk resident onboarding via CSV or link
  • Assign and manage security contracts
  • Zone-based alert routing
  • Subscription and billing management
  • Monthly incident analytics reports
  • POPIA-compliant data management
